title: Wordlist Brute‑Force with break
description: Iterate over a wordlist, try each password, and stop when the correct one is found.
problemStatement: Create `brute_force.py` with a list of possible passwords: `["123456", "password", "admin", "letmein", "welcome"]`. The correct password is `"admin"`. Loop through the list using a `for` loop. For each password, print "Trying: [password]". If it matches the correct password, print "Access granted!" and **break** out of the loop. If you finish the loop without finding it (you can use a loop‑else), print "Password not found in wordlist". Test by changing the correct password to something not in the list to see the else execute.
hints: Add an `else:` after the for loop to handle not found.
expectedOutput:
Trying: 123456
Trying: password
Trying: admin
Access granted!
(If not found, after list ends: 'Password not found in wordlist')
